title: Demand for Community Care Apartments and Assisted Living Developments, and Review of Affordability and Eligibility Rules of These Options
what_it_is: Demand for Community Care Apartments and Assisted Living Developments, and Review of Affordability and Eligibility Rules of These Options

sections.label: Community care apartment demand and affordability
sections.summary: MP asks reasons for lower-than-expected CCA subscription demand and how affordability, including Basic Service Package price, can improve.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (a) on the reasons for the lower-than-expected subscription demand for the recent launches of the community care apartments; and (b) how the overall affordability can be further improved, including the price of the basic service package.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Our approach is to provide a range of housing and care options for seniors – different services, different price points, subsidised and commercial products.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We will have a million seniors aged 65 and above by 2030.

sections.label: CCA demand and lowered fees
sections.summary: Demand for CCAs moderated with more community options, and subsidies extended to CCA residents led to lowered Basic Service Package fees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Notwithstanding, with more options to age well in the community, demand for CCAs has moderated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: With the roll-out of subsidised services such as AACs and HPC+, we extended the same level of subsidies to CCA residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: That is a key reason why we have lowered the CCA Basic Service Package fees.

sections.label: BTO take-up rates
sections.summary: About seven in 10 units across the past five BTO projects were taken up, with Fernvale Plains most recently about 50%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: About seven in 10 units across the past five Build-To-Order (BTO) projects were taken up by the end of each BTO selection.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Most recently, for Fernvale Plains, it was about 50%.

sections.label: Parry Avenue pilot project
sections.summary: The Parry Avenue pilot project may be more suitable for a niche segment of the community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The Parry Avenue pilot project maybe more suitable for a niche segment of the community.

sections.label: Transparency on all-in cost
sections.summary: On requiring operators to publish all-in cost before residents commit, the Minister fully agrees with the Member on transparency.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: On the Member's second supplementary question on whether the Government require the operator to publish the all-in cost before residents commit, I fully agree with the Member on the principle of transparency.

sections.label: CCA testing and Bukit Panjang initiatives
sections.summary: CCA is a new product being market-tested and not for every senior, with Bukit Panjang getting enhanced AAC and ageing services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The CCA is a new product and something with which we are testing the market to see whether seniors find it useful, and I must add that CCA is not the solution for every senior.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For Bukit Panjang, for instance, where we know there is a higher density of seniors, it is one of the Age Well Neighbourhoods, and we are bringing initiatives, like enhanced AAC network, different active ageing healthcare and aged care services, closer to seniors in these neighbourhoods.

sections.label: Social and active ageing programs
sections.summary: Social and active ageing programs will be provided through AAC touch points near CCAs, mostly free-of-charge, and learning will continue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Social and active ageing programs will be provided through the AAC touch points near the CCAs, with most of the activities being free-of-charge and we will continue to learn from this experience.

sections.label: CCAs and senior care options
sections.summary: CCAs are one option for some seniors wanting care services, with many other options including 2-room Flexi flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: CCAs are just one of the options for certain group of seniors that want to take up care services as part of CCAs, but many others options are available, including 2-room Flexi flats.
